title: Task Editing and Checkout Update

sections.name: Checkout
items: Checkout now starts immediately and pauses only when a real CAPTCHA needs to be solved.
Checkout resumes automatically in the same harvester after the CAPTCHA is completed.

sections.name: Tasks
items: Editing a profile or proxy no longer clears the task SKU.
Task editing now uses grouped profile and proxy selectors.
Product links display their SKU, and task rows show the proxy group and active proxy.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
